title: PDE aspects of the dynamical optimal transport in the Lorentzian setting
summary: One of the crucial features of optimal transport on Riemannian manifolds is the equivalence of the `static', original, formulation of the problem and of the `dynamic' one, based on the study of the continuity equation. This furnishes the key link between Wasserstein geometry and PDEs that has found so many applications in the last 20 years. In this paper we investigate this kind of equivalence on spacetimes.
